title: publish-report
description: Result of `workspace doctor --publish-safety`: what stops a commit or a push of the workspace (block), what is only reported (warn) and what stays out of git (local-only). A detail never holds a secret value.

finding.description: One finding of a publish-safety rule.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the workspace root.

detail.description: What was found: the rule, the place and a mask instead of any secret value.

line.description: Line of the first match in a text file.

files_checked.description: Number of files the rules were applied to.

block.description: Findings that forbid a commit and a push (PUBLISH_BLOCKED).

warn.description: Findings that are reported and do not stop a commit.

local_only.description: Files that stay out of git on this machine, sorted by path.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the workspace root.

reason.description: Why the file is not in git: larger than max_tracked_bytes, or binary and larger than max_binary_tracked_bytes.

verdict.description: block when any finding blocks, else warn when any finding warns, else ok.
